"""
svd from linearalgebra
ElementSets from MeshConnectivity
VertexOneRing from PointCloudNeighborhoods(M)
M : EdgeMesh 
x_i ∈ ℝ^3 

V, E = ElementSets( M )

Normal(v) = vv_*,3 where v ∈ V,
N = VertexOneRing(v),
p̄ = (∑_(n ∈ N) x_n)/|N|,
d = {x_v-p̄ for v ∈ N},
m_i,* = d_i,
u, `∑`, vv = svd(m)
"""
import numpy as np
import scipy
import scipy.linalg
from scipy import sparse
from scipy.integrate import quad, solve_ivp
from scipy.optimize import minimize
from triangle_mesh import *


class heartlib:
    def __init__(self, M, x):
        rhs = M.ElementSets()
        self.V = rhs[0]
        self.E = rhs[1]
        dimv_0 = M.n_vertices()
        dime_0 = M.n_edges()
        dimf_0 = M.n_faces()
        x = np.asarray(x, dtype=np.float64)
        dim_0 = x.shape[0]
        assert x.shape == (dim_0, 3, )

        self.M = M
        self.x = x
        _PointCloudNeighborhoods = self.PointCloudNeighborhoods(M)
        self.VertexOneRing = _PointCloudNeighborhoods.VertexOneRing
        self.VertexOneRing_0 = _PointCloudNeighborhoods.VertexOneRing_0
        pass

    def Normal(self, v):
        assert np.ndim(v) == 0
        assert v in self.V

        # N = VertexOneRing(v)
        N = self.VertexOneRing(v)

        # p̄ = (∑_(n ∈ N) x_n)/|N|
        sum_0 = np.zeros((3, ))
        for n in N:
            sum_0 += self.x[n]
        p̄ = ((sum_0)) / (len(N))

        # d = {x_v-p̄ for v ∈ N}
        Normalset_0 = set()
        set_range = N
        for v in set_range:
            Normalset_0.add(tuple(np.ravel(self.x[v] - p̄)))
        d = Normalset_0

        # m_i,* = d_i
        m = np.zeros((len(d), 3))
        for i in range(1, len(d)+1):
            m[i-1, :] = sorted(d)[i-1]

        svd = np.linalg.svd(m)
        rhs_1 = (svd[0], svd[1], svd[2].T)
        u = rhs_1[0]
        n_ary_summation = rhs_1[1]
        vv = rhs_1[2]
        return vv[:, 3-1]
    class PointCloudNeighborhoods:
        def __init__(self, M):
            rhs = M.ElementSets()
            self.V = rhs[0]
            self.E = rhs[1]
            dimv_0 = M.n_vertices()
            dime_0 = M.n_edges()
            dimf_0 = M.n_faces()
            self.M = M
            _FundamentalPointCloudAccessors = self.FundamentalPointCloudAccessors(M)
            self.Vertices = _FundamentalPointCloudAccessors.Vertices
            self.Vertices_0 = _FundamentalPointCloudAccessors.Vertices_0
            self.Vertices_1 = _FundamentalPointCloudAccessors.Vertices_1
            self.Edges = _FundamentalPointCloudAccessors.Edges
            self.Edges_0 = _FundamentalPointCloudAccessors.Edges_0
            # `∂⁰` = BoundaryMatrices(M)
            self.dee0 = M.BoundaryMatrices()
            # `∂⁰ᵀ` = `∂⁰`ᵀ
            self.dee0T = self.dee0.T
            # `B⁰` = UnsignedBoundaryMatrices(M)
            self.B0 = M.UnsignedBoundaryMatrices()
            # `B⁰ᵀ` = `B⁰`ᵀ
            self.B0T = self.B0.T
        def VertexOneRing(self, v):
            assert np.ndim(v) == 0
            assert v in self.V
            return nonzeros(self.B0 @ (self.B0T @ indicator({v}, self.M.n_vertices()))) - {v}
        def VertexOneRing_0(self, v):
            v = frozenset(v)
            return nonzeros(self.B0 @ (self.B0T @ indicator(v, self.M.n_vertices()))) - v
        def EdgeIndex(self, i, j):
            assert np.ndim(i) == 0
            assert np.ndim(j) == 0
            assert i in self.V
            assert j in self.V
            # eset = edgeset(NonZeros(`∂⁰ᵀ` IndicatorVector({i}))) ∩ edgeset(NonZeros(`∂⁰ᵀ` IndicatorVector({j})))
            eset = frozenset.intersection(nonzeros(self.dee0T @ indicator({i}, self.M.n_vertices())), nonzeros(self.dee0T @ indicator({j}, self.M.n_vertices())))
            return sorted(eset)[1-1]
        class FundamentalPointCloudAccessors:
            def __init__(self, M):
                rhs = M.ElementSets()
                self.V = rhs[0]
                self.E = rhs[1]
                dimv_0 = M.n_vertices()
                dime_0 = M.n_edges()
                dimf_0 = M.n_faces()
                self.M = M
                # dee0 = BoundaryMatrices(M)
                self.dee0 = M.BoundaryMatrices()
                # B0 = UnsignedBoundaryMatrices(M)
                self.B0 = M.UnsignedBoundaryMatrices()
                # B0T = B0ᵀ
                self.B0T = self.B0.T
            def Vertices(self, S):
                return S[1-1]
            def Edges(self, S):
                return S[2-1]
            def Vertices_0(self, e):
                assert np.ndim(e) == 0
                assert e in self.E
                return nonzeros(self.B0 @ indicator({e}, self.M.n_edges()))
            def Vertices_1(self, H):
                H = frozenset(H)
                return nonzeros(self.B0 @ indicator(H, self.M.n_edges()))
            def Edges_0(self, v):
                assert np.ndim(v) == 0
                assert v in self.V
                return nonzeros(self.B0T @ indicator({v}, self.M.n_vertices()))
